    theorem LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.exists_transitRadicalPowerGenerator {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] [IsAlgClosed k] [∀ (T : C), IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k C] (X : C) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ X)] [Module.Finite k (CategoryTheory.End X)] :

    Every endpoint has a transit-oriented radical-power generator. A zero radical uses tau = 0; otherwise the maximal-radical-span construction and algebraic closedness provide the usual nonzero BGRS parameter.

    Source-dual endpoint-generator existence, with the same zero-radical case split.

    Exact classification of forbidden crosses for one arrow #

    For a length-one landing in the opposite closed zigzag, a forbidden cross cannot have both outer paths equal to identities: the landing itself would then be a path through the supposedly empty middle Hom. Since all paths have length at most one, every cross therefore has an outgoing arrow on its left or an incoming arrow on its right. The following two submodules make that source-level dichotomy explicit.
